I was playing Fallout New Vegas and one of the characters had survived being lit on fire and thrown into the grand canyon. Is this possible?
Is it possible to survive being lit on fire and thrown into the Grand Canyon?
Not possible. The Grand Canyon is 1800m at its deepest. Acceleration at 1g is 9.8m/s/s. Ignoring air friction, a 70kg person's velocity at impact would be 676.19 kph.

With air resistance though, humans have a terminal velocity of only 200 kph (120 mph). Every once in a while, you see stories on the news about skydivers whose parachutes fail to open, and they smack into ground but survive. Of course... they're not on fire... and they get immediate medical attention. So I guess they have that going for them. I wouldn't expect someone in the situation described to have much hope... haha
